what_it_is: Yoshi Circuit TT Ghost. Beats Staff Ghost.

gamefaqs.section: GameCube USB Memory Adapter Save (North America)

format: GCI: the 64-byte card directory entry (GM4E01, file '5#R%#*EV*31!!!ECS^`3>GE>*2"5!aa', 5 blocks, modified 2023-09-17 21:23:35, comment 'Mario Kart: Double Dash!! / Ghost Data 2:29:682') then 5 x 8 KiB blocks = 41024 bytes

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gc-gci.py place <file> <GC/USA/Card A>: copies the GCI unchanged into the GCI folder under Dolphin's own name for it

dolphin-emu.frontend: tools/retro-run, OpenGL 4.1 core context, options scripts/gc/dolphin-single-core.opt (CPU thread off, OSD off); save in <savedir>/User/GC/USA/Card A/ (the core's GCI folder)
dolphin-emu.detail: Time Trials > Star Cup > Yoshi Circuit opens LOAD GHOST DATA: Slot A, Yoshi Circuit ghost data 1; Slot A lists '1 Yoshi Circuit 2:29:682 MII', Yoshi and Toad, 09/17/23 (the file's own comment: Ghost Data 2:29:682); baseline (no save): no LOAD GHOST DATA screen, the Time Trial on Yoshi Circuit starts

dolphin-emu@dolphin.frontend: Dolphin.app, isolated user folder (-u), batch mode (-b), input from a TAS movie (-m) made with work/standalone/tools/gen_dtm.py, frame dump; save in <user>/GC/USA/Card A/ (GCI folder)
dolphin-emu@dolphin.detail: Time Trials > Star Cup > Yoshi Circuit opens LOAD GHOST DATA: Slot A, Yoshi Circuit ghost data 1; Slot A lists '1 Yoshi Circuit 2:29:682 MII', Yoshi and Toad, 09/17/23 (the file's own comment: Ghost Data 2:29:682); baseline (no save): no LOAD GHOST DATA screen, the Time Trial on Yoshi Circuit starts

note: A Time Trial ghost is a card file of its own (5 blocks, file name of encoded characters); with no main data on the card the game first asks to create it (YES), so both cores also wrote a new 'MarioKart Double Dash!!' file beside it in the work folder.
